lines.trans: Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.
Perfect timing, Salma—Tariq is lifting the third stone right now!
Hold the lantern low, Nour, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!
Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!
That sounds like smart old engineering—and look what is resting in the middle.
It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!
May I reach down and lift it out, Tariq?
Go ahead, Nour, both hands—tell us if it feels wet or heavy.
It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!

words.gloss: in a way / in a shape

lines.trans: Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!
I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.

words.gloss: to his place / to its place
at a table / with a table

lines.trans: See you soon!

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for seeing a group of people.

examples.trans: I will see you tomorrow at school.

examples.text: يلا مع السلامة، أشوفكم الأسبوع الجاي إن شاء الله.
examples.trans: Alright, goodbye—see you all next week, God willing.

meanings.note: Conditional conjunction. Pronounced 'iza' in some dialects.

examples.trans: If you want, we can go together.

examples.text: اذا خلصت شغلك بكير، مرّ علينا نشرب شاي.
examples.trans: If you finish your work early, stop by our place for tea.

meanings.note: Command to go back.

examples.trans: Go back to your work.

examples.text: ارجع بكير عالبيت قبل ما تظلّم الدنيا.
examples.trans: Come back home early before it gets dark.

meanings.note: Command to prop up or lean something.

examples.trans: Lean the ladder against the wall.

examples.text: اسند الباب بحجر عشان الهوا ما يسكره.
examples.trans: Prop the door open with a stone so the wind doesn't shut it.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for 'thing' (شيء).

examples.trans: I want to buy something tasty.

examples.text: في اشي مهم لازم أحكيلك إياه اليوم.
examples.trans: There's something important I need to tell you today.

meanings.note: The color yellow.

examples.trans: The color of the flower is yellow.

examples.text: اشتريت دفتر اصفر عشان أكتب فيه الملاحظات.
examples.trans: I bought a yellow notebook to write notes in.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian pronunciation of the ordinal number third.

examples.trans: He lives on the third floor.

examples.text: مكتب المحامي موجود بالطابق التالت عاليمين.
examples.trans: The lawyer's office is on the third floor on the right.

meanings.note: A concatenated transcription error from a corpus, merging 'the two' and 'tell us'.

examples.text: الساعة التنتين احكيلنا شو صار معك.
examples.trans: At two o'clock, tell us what happened with you.

examples.text: الساعة التنتين احكيلنا شو طلع معك بالاجتماع.
examples.trans: At two o'clock, tell us what came out of the meeting.

meanings.note: Plural of 'jaanib', referring to physical sides or metaphorical aspects.

examples.text: لازم ندرس الموضوع من كل الجوانب.
examples.trans: We must study the issue from all aspects.

examples.text: فحصنا الخطة من جميع الجوانب قبل ما نوقع العقد.
examples.trans: We examined the plan from every angle before signing the contract.

meanings.note: Means stone, but recently widely used for quarantine (Hajar siHHi).

examples.trans: This stone is very heavy.

examples.text: حطينا الحجر الكبير تحت العجل عشان ما ترجع السيارة.
examples.trans: We put the big rock under the tire so the car wouldn't roll back.

meanings.note: The staple food in Jordan, often a symbol of livelihood.

examples.trans: I bought the bread from the bakery in the morning.

examples.text: ريحة الخبز السخن طالعة من الفرن على الشارع.
examples.trans: The smell of warm bread is wafting out of the bakery onto the street.

meanings.note: Goodness, kindness, or general prosperity/wealth.

examples.text: يعطيك ألف عافية، كتر الله من الخير.
examples.trans: May God give you health, may God increase the good/wealth.

examples.text: إن شاء الله السنة الجديدة بتجيب الخير للجميع.
examples.trans: Hopefully the new year brings goodness and blessings to everyone.

meanings.note: Can mean either the season of winter or the rain itself in Jordanian.

examples.trans: The rain started falling.

examples.text: بالشتا بنشغل الصوبة وبنشرب سحلب سخن.
examples.trans: In winter we turn on the heater and drink hot sahlab.

meanings.note: Refers to the floor of a building.

examples.trans: My house is on the second floor.

examples.text: المصعد عطلان فطلعنا على الطابق الرابع مشي.
examples.trans: The elevator is out of order, so we walked up to the fourth floor.

meanings.note: Usually refers to a traditional or Ramadan lantern.

examples.trans: We hung the lantern for Ramadan.

examples.text: الأطفال فرحوا بالفانوس المضيء بأول يوم رمضان.
examples.trans: The children were thrilled with the lit lantern on the first day of Ramadan.

meanings.note: Describes something situated above or on an upper level.

examples.trans: The upstairs neighbor is annoying.

examples.text: الدرج الفوقاني بده تنظيف وشطف من الغبرة.
examples.trans: The upper staircase needs cleaning and mopping from the dust.

meanings.note: Literal treasure or used metaphorically for something valuable.

examples.trans: They found the treasure on the map.

examples.text: القصة بتحكي عن شباب بدوروا على الكنز المخبي بالمغارة.
examples.trans: The story is about young people searching for the treasure hidden in the cave.

meanings.note: Describes a square shape or sometimes a sturdy build.

examples.trans: The square table takes up space.

examples.text: حطينا الصينية المربعة على السفرة بنص الصالة.
examples.trans: We placed the square tray on the dining spread in the middle of the hall.

meanings.note: Can mean a tidy female/object, or a mattress (though 'farshe' is more common for mattress in Jordan).

examples.trans: I like the neat girl.

examples.text: الغرفة المرتبة بتفتح النفس للدراسة والشغل.
examples.trans: A tidy room makes you feel ready to study and work.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for a flat surface (masculine).

examples.trans: The flat surface is better for building.

examples.text: الشاش الموجود بالجهاز الجديد هو المسطح مش المنحني.
examples.trans: The screen on the new device is the flat one, not the curved one.

meanings.note: Full (feminine).

examples.trans: The full bottle is very heavy.

examples.text: شلت الكيسة المليانة أغراض من السيارة للمطبخ.
examples.trans: I carried the bag full of groceries from the car to the kitchen.

meanings.note: I extend or stretch out.

examples.text: لازم امد إيدي عشان أطول الكتاب.
examples.trans: I have to reach out my hand to get the book.

examples.text: بحاول امد رجلي شوي بعد القعدة الطويلة بالسيارة.
examples.trans: I'm trying to stretch my legs out a bit after sitting so long in the car.

meanings.note: Or (conjunction).

examples.trans: Do you want tea or coffee?

examples.text: بتحب العسل الدافي او كريمة الليمون؟
examples.trans: Do you prefer warm honey or lemon icing?

meanings.note: Expression of surprise, realization, or reaction.

examples.trans: Oh, I forgot the keys in the car!
Oh, we forgot to get the honey jar ready!

meanings.note: My hand.

examples.trans: My hand hurts from work.

examples.text: مسكت الكتاب بإيدي التنتين عشان ما يوقع.
examples.trans: I held the book with both my hands so it would not drop.

meanings.note: In four or with four (masculine form modifying feminine nouns).

examples.trans: I finished the work in four hours.

examples.text: زين الكيكة باربع حبات توت كبار.
examples.trans: He decorated the cake with four big berries.

meanings.note: Used to indicate the center of something or splitting something equally.

examples.trans: Split the apple in half.
Tin Two is placed right in the middle.

meanings.note: Often used to describe arriving safely or living without danger.

examples.trans: We arrived home safely.
We came down the stairs safely and reached the kitchen.

meanings.note: Directing speech to a female, meaning she holds responsibility or literal items in her hands.

examples.trans: The decision is in your hands now.
Hold the tin with both of your hands.

meanings.note: Very common verb meaning to become visible or clear.

examples.trans: Tiredness shows on him.

examples.text: هادا الكرت ببين قديم كتير ومكتوب بقلم حبر.
examples.trans: This card looks very old and is written in fountain pen.

meanings.note: Refers to sewing or tying something using a piece of thread.

examples.trans: I sewed the button with black thread.

examples.text: العلبة الخشب مربوطة بخيط قنب متين.
examples.trans: The wooden box is tied with sturdy hemp string.

meanings.note: Used for lifting objects, raising volume, or increasing prices.

examples.trans: I lift the heavy box.

examples.text: كل يوم الصبح برفع الغطا عن العجين.
examples.trans: Every morning he lifts the cover off the dough.

بشكل.gloss: in a way / in a shape

meanings.en: in a way / in a shape
meanings.note: Often used as a prefix for adverbs, e.g., 'bi-shakil ʿām' (generally).

examples.trans: We need to work in a faster way.
The ingredients are mixed in a completely even way.

بطاولة.gloss: at a table / with a table

meanings.en: at a table / with a table
meanings.note: Indicates physical interaction or location relative to a table.

examples.trans: I bumped my leg against a table.

examples.text: حطينا العلبة بطاولة المطبخ جنب الشباك.
examples.trans: We set the tin on the kitchen table beside the window.

meanings.note: Expresses the action of astonishing or surprising someone.

examples.trans: I always surprise my friends on their birthdays.

examples.text: طارق دايما بفاجئ أهله بوصفات جديدة.
examples.trans: Tariq always surprises his family with new recipes.

meanings.note: Used to refer to something made of or covered with fabric.

examples.trans: He covered the table with a red cloth.

examples.text: غطينا سلة الخبز بقماش كتان أبيض.
examples.trans: We covered the bread basket with white linen cloth.

meanings.note: Used to contrast two different situations or actions happening at the same time.

examples.text: هو كان بدرس بينما أنا كنت بلعب.
examples.trans: He was studying while I was playing.

examples.text: كنت بحضر الشاي بينما سلمى بتقطع الكيكة.
examples.trans: I was preparing the tea while Salma was slicing the cake.

meanings.note: Often used to refer to dough rising due to yeast.

examples.trans: The dough fermented and became ready for baking.

examples.text: تركنا العجينة ساعة كاملة عشان تخمر منيح.
examples.trans: We left the dough a full hour so it would rise well.

meanings.note: The number 9.

examples.trans: I have nine books on the shelf.

examples.text: الساعة تسعة الصبح رح نلتقي عند النافورة.
examples.trans: At nine in the morning we will meet by the fountain.

meanings.note: Refers to moving upwards, outside, or appearing.

examples.trans: I want you (pl.) to go outside.

examples.text: قبل ما تطلعوا عالبلكونة تأكدوا من المفتاح.
examples.trans: Before you all go out onto the balcony check the key.

meanings.note: Action of opening a door, book, or shop.

examples.trans: Can you open the window a little bit?

examples.text: استنينا البوابة تفتح عشان ندخل الساحة.
examples.trans: We waited for the gate to open so we could enter the courtyard.

meanings.note: Used as a polite offering, invitation to enter, or handing something to a female.

examples.trans: Here you go, the coffee is ready.

examples.text: تفضلي كاسة شاي بالنعناع يا خالتي.
examples.trans: Please have a glass of mint tea, auntie.

meanings.note: Used to describe a heavy object or a burdensome person.

examples.trans: This bag is very heavy for me.

examples.text: الصينية الحديد تقيلة كتير لما تكون مليانة.
examples.trans: The iron tray is very heavy when it is full.

meanings.note: The number 2.

examples.trans: I only want two pieces, two are enough.

examples.text: جبنا كتابين تنين من رف الإعارة.
examples.trans: We brought two books from the lending shelf.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian verb meaning to bring something. Can also mean 'you (m) brought'.

examples.trans: I brought a gift with me for you.

examples.text: جبت معي مرطبان عسل وزبدة بلدية.
examples.trans: I brought a jar of honey and local butter with me.

meanings.note: The standard Levantine Arabic word for 'inside' or 'inwards'.

examples.trans: Go inside the house, the weather is cold.
The metal tin is hidden inside the cupboard.

meanings.note: Active participle of feeling, commonly used to describe a present feeling or intuition about something feminine or a situation.

examples.trans: I feel (it) like it's going to rain today.

examples.text: حاسيتها رح تمطر قبل ما نوصل البيت.
examples.trans: I feel like it is going to rain before we get home.

meanings.note: Can mean 'border' or 'limit'. Can also be a shortened form of 'hada' meaning 'someone'.

examples.trans: Everything has a limit.

examples.text: وقفنا عند حد الحديقة قبل الزقاق.
examples.trans: We stopped at the boundary of the garden before the alley.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian verb for 'to speak, talk, tell' (بحكي / حكى).

examples.trans: Salma chats with all the neighbours.
Tell me everything I need to know.

meanings.note: Plural form of the color red, used to describe plural nouns.

examples.trans: I bought red apples.

examples.text: قطفنا حبات توت حمر وطازجة من الحديقة.
examples.trans: We picked fresh red berries from the garden.

meanings.note: Imperative form addressed to a group, asking them to take something feminine.

examples.trans: Here is the gift, take it with you.
The cake is ready; take it out to the balcony for tea.

meanings.note: Used for the material wood or timber.

examples.trans: This table is made of wood.

examples.text: الصندوق مصنوع من خشب جوز قديم وناعم.
examples.trans: The chest is made of smooth old walnut wood.

meanings.note: Colloquial Jordanian word for something thick, dense, or bulky, typically used for objects like books or clothes, rather than people.

examples.trans: Wear a thick jacket, the weather is cold.

examples.text: القماش خميل كتير وما بنفذ الضو منه.
examples.trans: The cloth is very thick and light does not pass through it.

meanings.note: Essential Jordanian word used for giving directions ('go straight') or to mean doing something immediately.

examples.trans: Walk straight and then turn right.

examples.text: امشي دغري لعند القوس وبعدين لف يسار.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead to the arch and then turn left.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian adjective (feminine: ذكية, plural: أذكياء).

examples.trans: Smart, quick thinking, Nour!
A clever idea solved the problem right away.

meanings.note: A combination of the word 'smart' (fem) and the imperative verb 'look' (pl).

examples.trans: The girl is smart, and look how she plays.

examples.text: الفكرة ذكية وشوفوا كيف رح تشتغل بسرعة.
examples.trans: The idea is clever—watch how it will work quickly.

meanings.note: Future tense marker in Jordanian and Levantine Arabic, equivalent to 'sa-' in MSA.

examples.trans: I will travel tomorrow.

examples.text: رح نذوق التلات كيكات بعد ما يبردوا شوي.
examples.trans: We will taste the three cakes after they cool a little.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a number, digit, or phone number.

examples.trans: What is your phone number?

examples.text: كل بطاقة إلها رقم متسلسل من واحد لعشرة.
examples.trans: Each card has a serial number from one to ten.

meanings.note: Common word for sand, whether at the beach or in construction.

examples.trans: The kids are playing in the sand.

examples.text: لقينا آثار خطوات صغيرة على رمل الساحة.
examples.trans: We found tiny footprints on the courtyard sand.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb meaning to slip or slide, often accidentally.

examples.trans: He slipped on the peel and fell.

examples.text: انتبه لا تزحلق عالبلاط المبلول عند النافورة.
examples.trans: Be careful not to slip on the wet tiles by the fountain.

meanings.note: Describes something hot (like food, water) for feminine nouns.

examples.trans: The water is very hot.

examples.text: انتبهي، الصينية لسه سخنة من الفرن.
examples.trans: Careful, the tray is still hot from the oven.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian verb for 'to see, look, check' (بشوف / شاف).

examples.trans: Look inside the suitcase, Nour!
I will see you tomorrow at breakfast.

meanings.note: Plural of 'shubbaak' (window).

examples.trans: Open the windows so the room airs out.

examples.text: فتحنا كل شبابيك المطبخ عشان يدخل هوا بارد.
examples.trans: We opened all the kitchen windows so cool air would come in.

meanings.note: An adjective describing something made of wax or having a waxy texture.

examples.trans: The texture of this plant is waxy.

examples.text: الورق المقوى إله ملمس شمعي ناعم.
examples.trans: The cardstock has a smooth, waxy texture.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian interrogative pronoun for 'what'.

examples.trans: What are you doing here?

examples.text: شو المكون السري اللي ضفتيه عالعجينة؟
examples.trans: What is the secret ingredient that you added to the batter?

meanings.note: Standard word for morning in both Classical and colloquial Arabic.

examples.trans: The weather is nice this morning.

examples.text: نسمات الصباح بالحديقة بتجيب ريحة الياسمين.
examples.trans: The morning breezes in the garden carry the scent of jasmine.

meanings.note: Used to describe arranging things in a row or styling hair.

examples.trans: He arranged the books on the shelf.

examples.text: صفف الكاسات بانتظام جنب إبريق الشاي.
examples.trans: He lined the glasses up neatly beside the teapot.

meanings.note: Plural of sayyad, context depends on whether it's near water.

examples.trans: The fishermen returned with a net full of fish.

examples.text: الصيادين بيعرفوا مسارات البحر من النجوم.
examples.trans: Sailors and fishermen know the sea routes by the stars.

meanings.note: Plural of ṭūba, referring to building bricks.

examples.trans: They brought bricks to build the wall.

examples.text: غطوا الزاوية بتلات طوبات حجر عشان العلامة.
examples.trans: They covered the corner with three stone bricks to mark it.

meanings.note: Preposition 'ala' + definite article + 'kamil' (complete).

examples.trans: The car veered off the road completely.

examples.text: اتأكدنا إنه الكيكة بردت عالكامل قبل التغطية.
examples.trans: We made sure the cake had cooled completely before glazing.

meanings.note: Used for baking dough.

examples.trans: We need to let the dough rest.

examples.text: تركنا عجينة الخبز ترتاح نص ساعة مغطاية.
examples.trans: We left the bread dough to rest covered for half an hour.

meanings.note: Extremely common colloquial conjunction used to indicate reason or purpose.

examples.trans: I went to the doctor because I am sick.

examples.text: استعملنا ورق نشافة عشان الحبر ما يطبع.
examples.trans: We used blotting paper so the ink would not stain.

meanings.note: Standard preposition for 'on', 'upon', or 'to'.

examples.trans: The book is on the table.

examples.text: حطينا الخريطة على الطاولة وبلشنا نحللها.
examples.trans: We laid the map on the table and began analysing it.

meanings.note: Preposition for 'in' or 'at', and very commonly used to mean 'there is/are' (existential).

examples.trans: There are many people in the market.

examples.text: في تلات بطاقات ملونة جوا الظرف الكبير.
examples.trans: There are three coloured cards inside the big envelope.

meanings.note: Preposition and adverb for time or sequence meaning 'prior to' or 'before'.

examples.trans: I have to arrive before five o'clock.

examples.text: غسلنا الفواكه منيح قبل ما نقطعها للتذوق.
examples.trans: We washed the fruit thoroughly before slicing it for the tasting.

meanings.note: Feminine adjective for things (not people) that are old, ancient, or outdated.

examples.trans: I have an old car but it's excellent.

examples.text: لقينا خريطة قديمة مرسومة بالحبر جوا غلاف الدفتر.
examples.trans: We found an old map drawn in ink inside the notebook cover.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for soon or near.

examples.trans: I will arrive very soon.

examples.text: سلمى رح ترجع قريب ومعها مرطبان العسل الجبلي.
examples.trans: Salma will be back soon bringing the jar of mountain honey.

meanings.note: Used to count items, or mean a portion, slice, or spare part.

examples.trans: I want a piece of cake please.

examples.text: كل واحد فينا أخذ قطعة صغيرة من كيكة اللوز.
examples.trans: Each one of us took a small piece of the almond cake.

meanings.note: The beloved beverage, often Arabic coffee or Turkish-style, and by extension a coffee shop.

examples.trans: Would you drink coffee or tea?

examples.text: حضرنا فنجان قهوة بالهيل للضيوف باللوبي.
examples.trans: We prepared a cup of cardamom coffee for the guests in the lobby.

meanings.note: Used to express resemblance, likelihood, or a hypothesis.

examples.trans: It looks as if it will rain today.

examples.text: كانه في ريحة قرفة طالعة من المطبخ التحتاني.
examples.trans: It seems as if there is a scent of cinnamon coming from the downstairs kitchen.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian prepositional phrase indicating motion directed to a lower place.

examples.text: انزل لتحت عشان تشوف الطابق الأرضي.
examples.trans: Go downwards so you can see the ground floor.

examples.text: انزلوا لتحت عالمطبخ بتلاقوا كل الصواني جاهزة.
examples.trans: Go downstairs to the kitchen and you will find all the trays ready.

meanings.note: Prepositional phrase denoting direction towards a particular but usually indefinite room.

examples.trans: They moved the patient to another room.

examples.text: نقلنا العلبة لغرفة الضيوف عشان التذوق.
examples.trans: We moved the tin to the guest room for the tasting.

meanings.note: Used in Jordan to mean a wrap or a sandwich (e.g. falafel or shawarma), or a turn in the road.

examples.trans: I want a falafel sandwich with fries.

examples.text: أخذنا لفة سريعة بالسوق واشترينا زعتر وفستق.
examples.trans: We took a quick stroll around the market and bought thyme and pistachios.

meanings.note: Refers to something designated to be eaten or used during the morning meal.

examples.trans: I bought cheese and olives for breakfast.

examples.text: حضرنا جبنة بلدية وزيتون وزعتر للفطور.
examples.trans: We prepared local cheese, olives, and thyme for breakfast.

لمكانه.gloss: to his place / to its place

meanings.en: to his place / to its place
meanings.note: Prepositional phrase denoting movement towards a specific location belonging to someone or something.

examples.trans: Return the book to its place.

examples.text: رجعنا الكتاب القديم لمكانه على الرف التالت.
examples.trans: We returned the old book to its place on the third shelf.

meanings.note: Used mostly as a negative particle for verbs ('didn't') or as a relative pronoun/conjunction ('what' or 'that which').

examples.trans: I haven't eaten anything since the morning.

examples.text: ما عرفت إنه العلبة فيها طابق سري من تحت.
examples.trans: I did not know that the box had a secret compartment underneath.

meanings.note: Used to describe something feminine or plural non-human that is soaked or damp with water.

examples.trans: The clothes are still wet, they haven't dried.

examples.text: الأوراق كانت مبلولة شوي من ندى الصباح بالحديقة.
examples.trans: The pages were slightly damp from the morning dew in the garden.

meanings.note: Feminine form of 'murabbaʿ', used to modify feminine nouns having a square shape.

examples.trans: The table is square in shape.

examples.text: اختاروا علبة مربعة صغيرة عشان البطاقات المتساوية.
examples.trans: They chose a small square tin for the equal-sized cards.

meanings.note: Describes a feminine object that is tied up, securely fastened, or restricted.

examples.trans: The cow is tied to the tree.

examples.text: الورقة مربوطة بخيط قنب ومختومة بشمع أحمر.
examples.trans: The paper is tied with hemp string and sealed with red wax.

meanings.note: Standard word for rain, commonly used across all registers of Arabic.

examples.trans: There is a lot of rain outside.

examples.text: نزل مطر خفيف وغسل أوراق الياسمين بالساحة.
examples.trans: Light rain fell and washed the jasmine leaves in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Refers to metallic materials or sometimes one's inner character.

examples.text: هذا الباب مصنوع من معدن قوي.
examples.trans: This door is made of strong metal.

examples.text: العلبة مصنوعة من معدن خفيف ما بصدي مع الوقت.
examples.trans: The box is made of a light metal that does not rust over time.

meanings.note: Very common word of approval or rating something highly.

examples.trans: Your work is excellent today.

examples.text: توازن السكر والليمون بهاي الكيكة ممتاز جدا.
examples.trans: The balance of sugar and lemon in this cake is truly excellent.

meanings.note: Used to ask for permission 'is it possible?' or to say 'perhaps'.

examples.trans: Is it possible for you to give me the pen?

examples.text: ممكن تعطينا الورقة التانية عشان نقارن الأرقام؟
examples.trans: Could you hand us the second sheet so we can compare the numbers?

meanings.note: Feminine adjective for dry objects.

examples.trans: The ground is dry, it needs water.

examples.text: الأعشاب بالمرطبان ناشفة ومحفوظة بعيد عن الرطوبة.
examples.trans: The herbs in the jar are dry and stored away from humidity.

meanings.note: Imperative addressed to a female to take something down, drop off, or lower a price.

examples.trans: Put the bag down on the floor.

examples.text: نزلي الصواني من الرف وحطيهم عالطاولة الكبيرة.
examples.trans: Bring (f.) the trays down from the shelf and put them on the big table.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for clean or tidy.

examples.trans: The house is clean after the deep cleaning.

examples.text: لوح الرخام نظيف وجاهز عشان نفرد عليه العجينة.
examples.trans: The marble slab is clean and ready for us to roll out the dough on.

meanings.note: Standard word for a river.

examples.trans: We sat next to the Jordan River.

examples.text: سافرنا عالأغوار وشفنا نهر اليرموك من بعيد.
examples.trans: We traveled to the Jordan Valley and saw the Yarmouk River from afar.

meanings.note: Everyday demonstrative pronoun for masculine singular objects.

examples.trans: This boy is very smart.

examples.text: هاد المحل ببيع أطيب كنافة نابلسية بعمان.
examples.trans: This shop sells the best Nabulsi kunafa in Amman.

meanings.note: Commonly used when referring to potholes on the road.

examples.trans: Watch out for this pothole.

examples.text: السيارة طبت في هالجورة بنص الشارع وطق العجل.
examples.trans: The car hit this pothole in the middle of the street and the tire blew out.

meanings.note: Demonstrative phrase pointing out a rock.

examples.trans: Throw this stone far away.

examples.text: شيل هالحجر من الممر قبل ما يتفركش فيه حدا.
examples.trans: Move this stone out of the walkway before someone trips over it.

meanings.note: Everyday demonstrative pronoun for feminine singular objects.

examples.trans: This girl is very smart.

examples.text: هاي الطريقة أسهل بكثير من اللي جربناها امبارح.
examples.trans: This method is much easier than the one we tried yesterday.

meanings.note: Very common adverb denoting the current time in Jordan and Palestine.

examples.trans: I want to go now.

examples.text: استناني دقيقتين، هسا بلبس وبنزل لعندك.
examples.trans: Wait two minutes for me; I'll get dressed and come down to you right now.

meanings.note: Refers to the field of engineering or geometry.

examples.trans: He is studying engineering at the university.

examples.text: تخرجت اختي من كلية هندسة العمارة السنة الماضية.
examples.trans: My sister graduated from the architecture engineering faculty last year.

meanings.note: Cardinal number or used as an indefinite pronoun.

examples.trans: There is someone asking about you.

examples.text: اشتريت كتاب واحد بس من المعرض لأنه كان غالي.
examples.trans: I bought just one book from the fair because it was expensive.

meanings.note: Refers to retrieving or pulling out an object.

examples.trans: I want to open the bag and take it out.

examples.text: لازم أجيب الكرسي عشان أوصل للخزانة واطولها.
examples.trans: I need to grab the chair so I can reach the cabinet and pull it out.

meanings.note: Used to describe something feminine that is light in weight or mild in intensity.

examples.trans: The bag is small and light.

examples.text: السلطة هاي زاكية وخفيفة على المعدة بعد العشا.
examples.trans: This salad is tasty and light on the stomach after dinner.

meanings.note: Can mean 'and in' or 'and there is' depending on context.

examples.text: رحنا على السوق وفي ناس كثير.
examples.trans: We went to the market and there are many people.

examples.text: عنا جلسة الصبح وفي اجتماع تاني بعد الضهر.
examples.trans: We have a session in the morning, and there is another meeting in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Time possessed by a second person masculine.

examples.trans: Take your time and don't rush.

examples.text: رتب وقتك منيح قبل أسبوع الامتحانات النهائية.
examples.trans: Organize your time well before final exams week.

meanings.note: Passive participle feminine form, often used for gifts or food.

examples.trans: The gift is ready and wrapped.

examples.text: الحلويات وصلت مرتبة ومغلفة بورق شفاف نظيف.
examples.trans: The sweets arrived neatly arranged and wrapped in clean clear wrap.

meanings.note: Used to describe something that lacks moisture.

examples.trans: The bread is old and dry.

examples.text: لمينا الغسيل عن الحبل لأنه صار دافي وناشف تماماً.
examples.trans: We took the laundry off the line because it got warm and completely dry.

meanings.note: Vocative particle used when addressing someone directly.

examples.trans: Oh Ahmed, come here.

examples.text: يا سيدي، تفضل اشرب معنا فنجان قهوة قبل ما تروح.
examples.trans: Sir, please come have a cup of coffee with us before you leave.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb meaning to trip over something or for a plan to fall apart.

examples.trans: Careful that he doesn't trip on the stairs.

examples.text: اربط بوتك منيح قبل ما تطلع تركض عشان ما تتفركش.
examples.trans: Tie your sneakers properly before going out to run so you don't trip.

meanings.note: Standard verb for entering.

examples.trans: Let him enter the room.

examples.text: افتح الباب للضيف عشان يدخل يقعد بالصالون.
examples.trans: Open the door for the guest so he can come in and sit in the living room.

meanings.note: Used for forbidding or stopping something from happening.

examples.trans: The law forbids smoking here.

examples.text: الشرطي يمنع الوقوف عند الزاوية وقت أزمة السير.
examples.trans: The officer forbids stopping at the corner during rush hour.
